messages:
Sofia Martinez: Noticed a mismatch on the AWS marketplace invoice for CloudRoute (reseller) 1: charges listed under both 'partner resale' and 'direct sale' for the same contract. Need quick help reconciling before close.
Ben Wright: Can you drop the invoice id and the two line rows? I can check mapping rules in the billing ETL.
Sofia Martinez: Invoice `INV-AWS-2026-04-CLR-1122`
Sofia Martinez: CSV snippet:
``
line_id,sku,description,amount
44210,CR-RESELL,CloudRoute monthly seats,9800
44211,DIR-SALE,CloudRoute monthly seats,9800
```
Claire O'Neal: Looks like our ETL matched one record to partner mapping and one to direct sales. Could be because partner marketplace account and our direct contract shared the same marketplace product code.
CloudRoute Billing: We submitted usage under partner account `CR-700` only. We did not report any direct sale. Attaching our usage submission id `sub-CR-2026-04-77`.
billing-bot: Auto-detect: potential mapping collision between partner and direct SKUs. Suggested tag: `marketplace-mapping-collision`.
Ben Wright: Opening AWS support case to confirm which customer mapping they used when generating the consolidated bill. Case #AWS-2026-15890 opened.
Sofia Martinez: For accounting: please do not recognize the direct-sale line until AWS confirms. I'll mark invoice as disputed and adjust month-end reserves.
Claire O'Neal: I'll push a small ETL patch to treat matching product_code collisions as flagged and send a report to finance. Deploying to staging now.
CloudRoute Billing: We can provide a signed statement that we only submitted partner usage. If AWS confirms an error, we'll accept partner-level reversal.
AWS Marketplace Support: Received case. Please provide partner registration `CR-700` and the marketplace product ARN if possible. We'll investigate duplicate mapping in bill generation.
Sofia Martinez: Partner ID `CR-700`. Product ARN `arn:aws:marketplace:us-east-1::product/0a1b2c3d4e`. Uploaded both to the support case.
Ben Wright: Noted. I'll also add a temporary rule in revenue recognition to block that specific invoice id.
billing-bot: Reminder: month-end in 3 days. If unresolved, escalate to RevOps.
Sofia Martinez: Thanks team. I'll follow up in-thread with AWS case updates. If AWS is slow, we may need an interim credit memo to CloudRoute; Claire can you confirm if ops can generate that?
Claire O'Neal: Ops can issue a provisional credit memo once finance signs off. Leave this with finance to approve.
Sofia Martinez: On it. :clipboard:
